title: Analytics
intro: Figures come from what is recorded in the workbench. Rates cover the candidates added to a position in the selected dates.

timeToFill.name: Time-to-Fill
timeToFill.formula: Median days from the position entering sourcing (or being created) to its offer being accepted and the position filled. Positions filled in the selected dates.

timeToInterview.name: Time-to-Interview
timeToInterview.formula: Median days from a candidate's first submission to the client to their first interview.

outreachResponseRate.name: Outreach Response Rate
outreachResponseRate.formula: Candidates who replied to outreach ÷ candidates who were sent at least one touch. A recorded "no response" does not count as a reply.

submissionToInterview.name: Submission-to-Interview
submissionToInterview.formula: Candidates with at least one interview ÷ candidates submitted to the client.

interviewToOffer.name: Interview-to-Offer
interviewToOffer.formula: Candidates who reached an offer ÷ candidates with at least one interview.

interviewToHire.name: Interview-to-Hire
interviewToHire.formula: Candidates who started ÷ candidates with at least one interview. "Hire" means the candidate started.

sourceToHire.name: Source-to-Hire
sourceToHire.formula: Candidates who started ÷ candidates added. The table below splits this by source.

portalAdoption.name: Portal adoption
portalAdoption.formula: Approvals, submission reviews and feedback done by hiring managers and candidates in the portals ÷ all of them (including those the recruiter recorded for them).

stages.title: Candidate conversion by stage
stages.caption: Candidates reaching each stage, and the share of the previous stage that did

sources.title: Results by source
sources.caption: Candidates added, and how far each source's candidates got, with the share of the previous column

capacity.title: Recruiter capacity
capacity.intro: What matters is how much one recruiter can carry, not how much the AI wrote.
capacity.caption: Positions in sourcing, interviewing or offer per week, and the active time each filled position took
capacity.formula: Positions per week: the average, over the weeks of the range, of the positions owned by the recruiter that are in sourcing, interviewing or offer at the end of each week. Active days: days a filled position spent in those statuses, on hold excluded.
